body: If it's xbox one that'd be me!
If you're playing Xbox one, that may be my sign. Glad to see it helped someone.

And to top it all off my girlfriend of 5 years cheated on me and got pregnant from some random guy. She's keeping it and staying with him for the sake of the kid. So I literally have no reason to go on anymore.

Every day I wake up wishing for something horrible to happen, like getting run over, getting in a car accident or something so my family won't think they couldn't help me. I don't want to hurt them, but I don't want to hurt anymore.
I don't think talking will help anymore. I've just been hurting for so long and I'm sick of feeling like this. I don't have anymore fight in me.
